prompt: Subject: Gaze unfolding in flower shadows Main Focus: Close-up portrait of a woman in her 20s looking at the camera surrounded by small purple, blue, and pink flowers under a blue sky. Large face in center focus, featuring shadows of flower branches on cheeks and neck, wind-blown black hair, and white dress. Person/Expression: Smooth oval small face, wide amber eyes, thin natural eyebrows, clean nose, glossy plump coral pink lips. Head tilted slightly right looking straight at the camera with a quiet dreamy expression and slightly open mouth. Dark brown hair nearly black reaching below collarbone, thin center-parted bangs, fine strands blowing across cheeks and neck. Clothing/Pose: soft white thin cotton sleeveless dress. Deep V-neck, fine ruffles on straps, small cloth ribbon on left shoulder, fine gathers below chest. Facing front, arms naturally lowered off-screen, standing quietly among flowers. Background/Light: Dense small flowers (purple, blue, pink) and green stems in bottom-left and right foreground, partially blurred. Same flower field in the background with clear blue sky above. Warm afternoon direct sunlight from top-right illuminates face and shoulders, with sharp outlines of thin stems and leaves casting shadows on cheeks, nose, neck, and chest. Golden backlighting on hair edges. Composition/Camera: 3:4 vertical. Chest-up close portrait taken with a medium telephoto lens at eye level. Face placed large in the upper-center, from top of head to chest, with shoulders cut at the sides. Shot through foreground flowers with sharp focus on eyes and lips, with shallow depth of field creating soft round bokeh in both foreground and background flowers. Texture/Style: Photorealistic photo in a summer flower field. High-definition depiction of natural skin texture, faint healthy glow, moist lip gloss, eye reflections, light through individual hairs, fine wrinkles and seams in white cloth, and delicate petals and leaves. Transparent color palette harmonizing warm skin tones, vivid green, and soft purple and blue. Negative: Omission of floral shadows on face; change to background without flowers.

promptZh:
主体：
凝视在花影中消融

主要对象：
一位 20 多岁的女性特写肖像，正看向镜头，周围是蓝天下的紫色、蓝色和粉色小花。脸部位于画面中心，重点刻画花枝的影子投射在她的脸颊、颈部和胸前，黑发在风中飘动，身着 白色连衣裙。

人物/表情：
光滑的椭圆形脸庞，琥珀色的大眼睛，自然的细眉，精致的鼻梁，以及带有光泽感的珊瑚粉色丰盈双唇。头部微微向右倾斜，直视镜头，表情安静而梦幻，嘴唇微张。深棕色近乎黑色的头发垂至锁骨下方，留着中分薄刘海，细碎的发丝在风中掠过脸颊和颈部。

服装/姿势：
由 柔软的白色薄棉布 制成的无袖连衣裙。采用深 V 领设计，肩带饰有精致的荷叶边，左肩配有小巧的布艺蝴蝶结，胸部下方有细密的褶皱。面向前方，双臂自然垂在身体两侧，静静地伫立在花丛中。

背景/光影：
左下方和右下方前景为茂密的紫色、蓝色、粉色小花和纤细的绿枝，部分呈现柔和的虚化效果。背景同样是花田和绿植，上方是澄澈的蓝天。午后温暖的直射阳光从右上方照亮脸部和肩膀，在脸颊、鼻梁、颈部、锁骨和胸前投下纤细枝叶的锐利阴影。发丝边缘带有金色的轮廓光。

构图/摄影：
垂直 3:4 比例。使用中焦镜头在视平线高度拍摄的胸部以上特写肖像。脸部位于上方中心，画面从头顶延伸至胸部，肩膀和上臂在两侧被裁切。透过前景花丛拍摄，焦点清晰地落在眼睛和嘴唇上，由于浅景深，前景和背景的花朵呈现出柔和的圆形虚化效果。

质感/风格：
在夏季花田拍摄的写实真人摄影。高清呈现自然的皮肤质感和淡淡的红晕、水润的唇彩、眼睛的倒影、穿过发丝的光线、白色布料的细微褶皱和接缝，以及花瓣和叶片的细腻纹理。色调通透，和谐地融合了温暖的肤色、鲜艳的绿色以及淡雅的紫色和蓝色。

负面提示词：
省略脸上的花影，更改为没有花朵的背景。
